mines.mine_notes: Underground gold-silver mine, Sonora, Mexico (acquired via the Bear Creek Mining combination, closed Q1 2026). 2025: produced ~30,000 oz gold. Q2 2026: 8,147 oz gold + 34,583 oz silver. 2,000 tpd plant; 69,284 ha concessions. Restructuring extinguished the legacy gold stream and settled ~US$121M of debt/stream burden; 2026 programs: infill/definition drilling, mine development, infrastructure upgrades (ventilation, electrical, pumping), tailings facility expansion, greenfield/brownfield exploration. FY2025 silver ounces not disclosed.

High-grade gold-silver project, Central Peru. Indicated resources: 356 koz gold @ 24.4 g/t and 8.4 Moz silver @ 579 g/t. Expanding Bonita vein system (~10 km south of Ayelen deposit): record 2025 intercepts incl. 23.9m @ 20.82 g/t Au + 31.53 g/t Ag (BOD-023) and 27.0m @ 5.28 g/t Au + 52.97 g/t Ag (BOD-025, Urpicha discovery).

World-class silver development project, Puno, Peru (acquired via Bear Creek Mining combination, closed Q1 2026). 229 Moz proven + probable silver reserves; measured + indicated resources 323 Moz Ag. 2026 drilling commenced.

notes: High-grade silver growth company. Listed on TSX:HSLV and NYSE American (from March 11, 2026). FY2025 Mercedes production ~30,000 oz gold (silver not disclosed); Q2 2026 Mercedes: 8,147 oz Au + 34,583 oz Ag. Combination with Bear Creek Mining (announced Dec 2025, closed Q1 2026) added the Corani silver project (229 Moz P&P Ag reserves) and the Mercedes mine; Highlander subscribed for 50M Bear Creek shares at C$0.36 (C$18M) pre-close and settled ~US$121M of Bear Creek debt/stream obligations, terminating the Mercedes gold stream. Corani drilling commenced April 2026. President & CEO Daniel Earle. All amounts in USD unless noted.
